old: ghṛtamvasya = ghṛtam u asya (u + a > va); 'u' is the emphatic particle. mimikṣe: perfect middle with passive sense. Object of ā vaha (the gods) is supplied. vakṣi: 2 sg. -si form of √vah with imperative force.
new: ghṛtamvasya = ghṛtam u asya (u + a > va); 'u' is the emphatic particle. mimikṣe: perfect middle with passive sense. Object of ā vaha (the gods) is supplied. vakṣi: 2 sg. -si form of √vah with imperative force. ghṛtam in the first clause is nom. or acc.; it could also be the object of mimikṣe, and '(in him)' is supplied.
why: reviewer (minor): ghṛtam is nom. and acc. alike; 'ghee is mixed (in him)' needs a supplied '(in him)' and a passive sense for a middle perfect. The alternative (ghṛtam as object of mimikṣe, he has mixed/taken ghee) should be mentioned, and confidence stays medium.
